sloka: उत्सवेषु च सर्वेषु पितेव परितुष्यति ।सत्यवादी महेष्वासो वृद्धसेवी जितेन्द्रियः ॥२-२-४१॥
transliteration: utsaveṣu ca sarveṣu piteva parituṣyati ।satyavādī maheṣvāso vṛddhasevī jitendriyaḥ ॥2-2-41॥

translations.english: . He is one who speaks the truth. He is a great archer, one who has conquered his senses and serves the aged. He speaks with a smile and protects dharma with all his heart.
